messages:
maya (Finance Ops): Zephyr Labs (ZPH-781) invoice INV-2025-01-19 is 52 days overdue, $92,740. Two dunning emails bounced. Recommend payment plan + temporary entitlements pause if no wire within 72h.

leo (Acct Mgmt): Oof. They mentioned a bank migration last month. I pinged their finance lead yesterday but no response.

billing-bot: status: INV-2025-01-19 \u2014 52d overdue \u2014 balance $92,740 \u2014 last_attempt: 2025-02-08T11:12:03Z \u2014 failure: R29 (corporate_account_closed)

sana (Revenue Ops): Hard pause could blow up the pilot. Suggest 2-pay plan: 30% now + 70% in 30 days, wire only, with acceleration on miss.

maya (Finance Ops): 30/70 ok if we get wire confirmation within 48h. Legal wants acceleration + cap collection fee at 12%.

oliver (Legal): Confirmed. Add clause for attorneys' fees and a requirement that payments be via traceable bank transfer (no card).

maya (Finance Ops): Draft I sent to CFO at 2025-02-10T09:00Z: 
```
Zephyr Labs Payment Proposal
Invoice: INV-2025-01-19
Amount: $92,740
Plan: 30% ($27,822) wire within 48h; remainder $64,918 due in 30 days via autopay wire.
Terms: Missed payment = full balance acceleration + 12% collection fee + interest 1.25%/mo. Attorneys' fees recoverable. Billable entitlements paused until initial wire clears.
Reply to accept or request call within 48h.
```

zephyr-cfo (external): We can do 25% today and the rest on 30/30. Treasury hit unexpected limits.

sana (Revenue Ops): 25% is below threshold. If they can provide a confirmed wire confirmation today plus a signed amendment we can accept 25% as exception.

maya (Finance Ops): I'll accept 25% conditional on same acceleration clause and signed amendment within 48h. Sending updated note.

billing-bot: account note added 2025-02-10: "Payment plan offered; conditional 25% accepted pending signed amendment and wire confirmation within 48h."

zephyr-cfo (external): Wire sent $23,185 (ref W-33421). Will email receipt in 30m.

maya (Finance Ops): Wire confirmed 2025-02-10T15:22Z. Posting payment and preparing amendment for signature.

last action: 2025-02-11T08:30Z  sana: scheduled follow-up with Zephyr CFO for 2025-02-11T10:00 to confirm signed amendment and next payment schedule.
